channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Russia Releases American Stephen Hubbard From Prison, State Media Reports
item.description: The move buys good will with President Trump while costing the President Vladimir V. Putin — who is wanted for war crimes — little.

item.title: NPR: 80 Israelis and Americans, including NY Democrat Brad Lander, detained in West Bank
item.description: U.S. Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander was detained along with about 80 American and Israeli rabbis and activists by Israeli security forces as they helped Palestinian olive harvesters.

item.title: BBC News: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson being investigated over alleged rape inside Westminster
item.description: While not naming the disgraced former MP, the Metropolitan Police has issued a statement confirming a 63-year-old man is being investigated.

item.title: The Guardian: Troubled waters: life during wartime for Iranians on the strait of Hormuz
item.description: Despite US-Israeli airstrikes and Tehran’s attacks on shipping, the waterway still has to provide a lifeline for those that live and work there Capt Farouq turns the wheel as he watches the ferry terminal of Bandar Abbas…

item.title: Al Jazeera: US congressional candidate Brad Lander freed after West Bank detention
item.description: Lander says dozens remain in Israeli custody after being detained while helping Palestinian farmers harvest olives.

item.title: Ars Technica: PHP warns it plans to release 2 emergency patches imminently
item.description: Unconfirmed report claims PHP2Shell exploit remotely executes code on PHP sites.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: She Was the DEA’s Premier Crypto Detective. The Clues Led Straight to Her Own Family
item.description: To escape the chaos of her Russian childhood, Lili Infante became an American law enforcement prodigy. She pioneered the DEA’s investigations of the dark web—never suspecting who she’d find hiding there.

item.title: WIRED Science: Telehealth Giant Hims Wants to Test Every Dude for Low Testosterone
item.description: The company plans to offer testosterone replacement therapy, marking its first foray into prescribing controlled substances.

item.title: The New Yorker: “An Unprecedented Case of Child Abuse”
item.description: In an L.A. criminal court, new details emerge about the mysterious couple who collected more than twenty babies through surrogacy.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Daily Horoscope by Madame Clairevoyant: October 21, 2026
item.description: You may find making decisions difficult today as friction arises between Venus and Neptune.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Developer Ziel Feldman Is Selling His Flashy Black-Marbled Triplex Penthouse
item.description: After trying to sell it in 2020, the former HFZ partner has cut the price by $11.5 million.
